mapper.sql: FROM user_read_history h JOIN book_info b ON b.id = h.book_id AND b.status = 0 JOIN book_category c ON c.id = b.category_id AND c.status = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT h.chapter_id AS history_chapter_id, h.chapter_name AS history_chapter_name, h.read_at AS history_read_at, h.create_time AS history_create_time, h.update_time AS history_update_time, b.id AS book_id, b.book_name AS book_name, b.author_name AS author_name, b.category_id AS category_id, c.category_name AS category_name, b.pic_url AS pic_url, b.book_desc AS book_desc, b.book_status AS book_status, b.word_count AS word_count, b.visit_count AS visit_count, b.chapter_count AS chapter_count, b.first_chapter_id AS first_chapter_id, b.last_chapter_id AS book_last_chapter_id, b.last_chapter_name AS book_last_chapter_name, b.last_chapter_update_time AS last_chapter_update_time, b.status AS book_status_flag, b.create_time AS book_create_time, b.update_time AS book_update_time
WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY h.read_at DESC, h.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT bc.id, bc.book_id AS bookId, bc.chapter_num AS chapterNum, bc.chapter_name AS chapterName, bc.word_count AS wordCount, bc.update_time AS updateTime, bc.create_time AS createTime FROM book_chapter bc WHERE bc.book_id = #{bookId} AND bc.id = #{chapterId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_read_history ( user_id, book_id, chapter_id, chapter_name, read_at, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{bookId}, #{chapterId}, #{chapterName}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE chapter_id = #{chapterId}, chapter_name = #{chapterName}, read_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE user_bookshelf SET last_chapter_id = #{chapterId}, last_chapter_name = #{chapterName}, last_read_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_id = #{bookId}
